name: Portal Time Machine
description: Replace the narrow per-execution rollback in DataRefresh with a portal-wide Time Machine: given a target date, restore every portal data source (yang pipeline, BD pipeline, news/trending) to its state as of 5:00 PM ET on that date. Research phase first — AE audit required to confirm S3 versioning status, BD snapshot feasibility, and DynamoDB scope before implementation.
phase: Phase 1: Implementation -- task orders issued to CloudOps (P1), OpalETL (P2), PartnerETL (P3). CLI audit complete 2026-03-10.

cli_findings_2026_03_10.prd_snapshot_approach: SUPERSEDED -- opal-data-bd versioning already on; use version-restore not snapshot archive
